'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, soldier! I recently worked out a deal to get my hands on a new kind of weapon. Same family as grenades, only a whole lot nastier. This isn't the sort of thing you hand out to just anyone. It takes discipline, good judgment. Plus the stock's limited.So if you want to buy this kind of serious hardware from me, prove you know how to put explosives on target. No shortcuts. I'd rather not have you blowing yourself up or turning one of your own into a casualty.Use whatever gets the job done. Underbarrel launchers, homemade grenades, doesn't matter to me. I only care about the results.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 20 PMC operatives with [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|grenades]] or [[Weapons#Grenade_launchers|grenade launchers]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Grenade Launchers|Grenade Launchers skill]] levels
* +4 [[Underbarrel Launchers|Underbarrel Launchers skill]] levels
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher]]
* 1× [[Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher]] at [[Prapor]] LL4
* Unlocks purchase of [[Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front)]] at [[Prapor]] LL4
{{quote|Yup, I've already heard about your handiwork. In your hands, an RShG's more of an asset than a liability. Like I said, these things are hard to come by, but I'll set one aside for you whenever I get a shipment.When you use it, make sure you've got plenty of space around you and nobody standing behind you. Oh, and read the instructions printed on the launcher. Don't be an idiot.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 20 PMC Operatives with [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|grenades]], [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|underbarrel grenade launchers]], [[Weapons#Grenade launchers|grenade launchers]] or [[Weapons#Rocket launchers|rocket launchers]]. Kills with the stationary [[AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launcher|AGS-30 grenade launcher]] do not count.

'''Note:''' The [[40x46mm M576 (MP-APERS) grenade]] does not work for this quest, because it is a buckshot cartridge instead of an actual grenade.
